openFindings.title: Public ripgrep wrapper is out of parity with the hidden-document retrieval lane
openFindings.evidence: Read-only import of the wrapper builders and assertRecipeParity returned three divergences: every shared-lane recipe contains --hidden and !**/.git/** while the wrapper recipes contain neither.
openFindings.recommendation: Align wrapper recipes with shared-lane flags and add dotted-path plus .git parity fixtures.
openFindings.scopeProof: Current source comparison and direct module import; no target writes.

openFindings.title: Copyable retrieval recipes omit the mandatory .git exclusion
openFindings.evidence: The prose calls --hidden and !**/.git/** mandatory, but all copyable structured, path, count, context and anchor commands omit the .git glob.
openFindings.recommendation: Add the .git exclusion to every prose recipe and assert documentation parity.
openFindings.scopeProof: Compared mandatory flag paragraph with every copyable recipe block.

openFindings.title: Wrapper silently discards positional arguments after the phrase
openFindings.evidence: parseArgs destructures only the first two positional values; direct import with path, foo, bar returned phrase foo and dropped bar without an error.
openFindings.recommendation: Reject extra positionals or explicitly join them and test the chosen contract.
openFindings.scopeProof: Current parser source and read-only parseArgs probe.

openFindings.title: HF-local availability accepts a ready server without proving it serves the requested model
openFindings.evidence: canLoad ignores its model option and returns available for ready/loading; auto-select calls it without a model, while readiness returns after setting isHealthy false on a health-model mismatch and the next embed receives the server's 404.
openFindings.recommendation: Pass the resolved model to the probe, require matching health identity, and throw before latching readiness; test that a mismatched resident is unavailable.
openFindings.scopeProof: Current call-graph read through availability, auto-select, readiness, embed and server mismatch response.

openFindings.title: Direct HF Unix-socket path lacks a post-bind socket type check before chmod and close-time unlink
openFindings.evidence: listenHttpServer calls chmodSync after listen without lstat/isSocket, and close unlinks the recorded path directly; the shared IPC server performs lstat, symlink and socket checks before chmod.
openFindings.recommendation: lstat after bind and before chmod, require a real socket, and verify the node again before close-time unlink; add injected-fs symlink/non-socket cases.
openFindings.scopeProof: Compared direct HF server path handling with shared IPC hardening; no unsafe live reproduction was run.

openFindings.title: HF client truncates fractional positive dimensions instead of rejecting malformed responses
openFindings.evidence: parseResponseDim accepts any finite positive number and returns Math.trunc; health and embed paths adopt the result as provider metadata.
openFindings.recommendation: Require a positive safe integer and add malformed-dimension response cases.
openFindings.scopeProof: Current client parser and adoption paths compared with the server integer-dimension invariant.

openFindings.title: Implementation summary asserts completion while its body and packet closure state are still scaffolding
openFindings.evidence: Summary metadata says Completed while the body is literal placeholders, continuity completion_pct is 0, the normative spec is In Progress, all acceptance rows are Unmet and T006-T010 remain unchecked.
openFindings.recommendation: Keep completion explicitly in progress until evidence is written, then reconcile summary, continuity metadata, spec status, acceptance rows, tasks and report in one closure update.
openFindings.scopeProof: Cross-read of packet docs and current doctor evidence pointers; no target writes.

openFindings.title: The advisor document-frontmatter parser treats a prefix as a closing fence
openFindings.evidence: parseDocFrontmatter finds the first newline followed by three dashes, so a content line such as ---not-a-fence can terminate the block and omit later keys or trigger phrases.
openFindings.recommendation: Require the delimiter to occupy the complete line with LF, CRLF or end-of-input, and add prefix-collision and Windows-line-ending fixtures.
openFindings.scopeProof: Compared current advisor parser with its focused tests and the strict whole-line delimiter in the spec-kit parser; no target writes.

openFindings.title: Advisor-local shared-payload producer vocabulary has drifted from the canonical contract
openFindings.evidence: The advisor copy accepts startup_brief and session_snapshot in addition to compact_merger, hook_cache and advisor, while the canonical spec-kit contract accepts only the latter three; the current advisor producer emits advisor only.
openFindings.recommendation: Remove unused literals or explicitly mark them local-only, then add a cross-package parity test for the intended vocabulary and rejection behavior.
openFindings.scopeProof: Compared both accepted unions and traced current advisor brief emission; no current extra-value producer was found and no target writes occurred.

openFindings.title: Forced-depth validation can accept duplicate state records when the full range is present
openFindings.evidence: forcedDepthIterationViolation applies unique() before comparing state iteration numbers with 1..cap, so a complete range plus a duplicate record is accepted when on-disk file count is complete.
openFindings.recommendation: Reject duplicate state iteration numbers before set comparison and add complete-range-plus-duplicate fixtures for synthesis and artifact fallback paths.
openFindings.scopeProof: Compared validator comments, state-record branch, on-disk count branch and focused duplicate/gap tests; no target writes.

openFindings.title: Custom HF model dimension semantics diverge between auto-selection and startup profile resolution
openFindings.evidence: Auto-selection persists dim 0 for a non-canonical HF model and the provider resolves its true dimension on first embed, while resolveActiveProfileDim returns 768 for every hf-local model unless an explicit dimension is set.
openFindings.recommendation: Use one explicit unknown/provisional contract or require EMBEDDING_DIM for custom startup profiles, defer materialization, and add a cross-path custom-model test.
openFindings.scopeProof: Compared auto-select, provider first-embed, startup profile and factory call sites; no target writes.

openFindings.title: Corpus indexing accepts Markdown symlinks whose real target is outside the repository
openFindings.evidence: The corpus walker records symlinked Markdown files by repo-relative link path without checking the resolved target is inside repoRoot, and generation reads through that link, allowing external file bytes to enter the committed index.
openFindings.recommendation: Reject or explicitly report symlinked Markdown targets outside repoRoot, preferably fail-closed for generation, and add an out-of-tree symlink fixture.
openFindings.scopeProof: Traced symlink walk, realpath deduplication, generator read path and existing in-tree symlink fixture; no target writes.
